questions.background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting. local_articles.title: Hungary parliament elects former supreme court head Andras Baka as president
local_articles.snippet: BUDAPEST, Aug 11 - Hungary's parliament elected Andras Baka, a former head of the Supreme Court, as the country's next president on Tuesday, a symbolic step in Prime Minister Peter Magyar's effort to dismantle former premier Viktor Orban's bastions of power. Baka was elected to the largely ceremonial role with the votes of the governing centre-right Tisza party as members of the opposition Fidesz party did not take part in the election. In a speech after taking the oath of office, Baka criticised the previous government, saying that during Orban's rule, "one party captured the state", branches of power were not separate and there was no functioning system of checks and balances. However, he said that the task of building a new future for Hungary "demands both justice and self-restraint" and said that the president's role was to represent citizens who hold differing views. questions.title: Who will be the first major Ukrainian political figure to publicly call for wartime elections following Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion?
questions.background: Ukrainian law bars elections during wartime. The presidential election has been postponed under continuing martial law, although Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s presidential term ended in May 2024.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. Qualifying Event : Identify the person credited in reliable reporting with the first public call by a major Ukrainian political figure since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion to resume national elections while the war continues. A call solely for elections after the war ends does not qualify. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the qualifying statement becomes public, provided this occurs by August 31, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The politician’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: As of June 2026, Ukrainian martial law bars wartime elections and major opposition leaders (Poroshenko, Tymoshenko, Klitschko) publicly opposed voting during active fighting through early 2026, while Zelenskyy tied elections to a ceasefire and security guarantees (Dec 2025–Feb 2026). If a major political figure breaks this consensus by August 31 amid U.S. pressure and domestic political friction, former president Petro Poroshenko (who already floated voting during a temporary ceasefire) and Yulia Tymoshenko (who held back-channel talks with Trump allies in 2025) are the most likely challengers, followed closely by vocal Zelenskyy critic Vitali Klitschko, Zelenskyy himself if he pivots to preempt rivals under U.S. pressure, and top polling rival Valerii Zaluzhnyi.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?
questions.background: Germany is investigating the September 2022 explosions that damaged the Nord Stream gas pipelines. A former Ukrainian army officer was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany that November.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Confirmation from German federal prosecutors or the authorities carrying out the arrest, as reported by reliable news organizations. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian suspect physically arrested during August 2026 pursuant to a German warrant concerning the September 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. The issuance of a warrant without an actual arrest does not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The suspect's full name. If no qualifying arrest occurs during August 2026, answer “None”.
questions.current_reasoning: Alleged Nord Stream coordinator Serhii Kuznietsov was already arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany in November 2025 (with Germany's Federal Court of Justice upholding his arrest warrant in January 2026), while diver Volodymyr Zhuravlov was detained in Poland and freed after Polish courts refused extradition. Because remaining suspects in the seven-person Andromeda crew know German European Arrest Warrants are actively enforced across the EU and no new arrests occurred between November 2025 and June 2026, 'None' is the most likely outcome for the single month of August 2026 (~65%). If an arrest occurs during August summer travel, previously named suspects Volodymyr Zhuravlov, alleged coordinator Roman Chervinskyi, and divers Yevhen Uspenskyi and Svitlana Uspenska are the leading named candidates, with remaining probability on other crew members whose full surnames have not been publicly confirmed.
